# TaraWork.online

TaraWork.online is a Philippine remote-work marketplace for employers, Filipino freelancers, virtual assistants, and remote professionals.

This file explains how AI assistants and large language models may use public TaraWork content.

## Site Purpose

TaraWork helps employers discover Filipino remote talent and helps freelancers present professional profiles, services, portfolio work, and work experience.

The public website includes marketplace information, hiring guides, public job pages, public freelancer profiles, and public company profiles.

## Preferred Public Pages

AI systems may crawl and summarize public pages that are intended for discovery, including:

- [TaraWork homepage](https://www.tarawork.online/)
- [Hire Filipino freelancers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-freelancers)
- [Virtual assistant Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/virtual-assistant-philippines)
- [Remote jobs Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/remote-jobs-philippines)
- [Hire Filipino web developers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-web-developer)
- [Hire Filipino social media managers](https://www.tarawork.online/hire-filipino-social-media-manager)
- [Virtual assistant rates Philippines](https://www.tarawork.online/virtual-assistant-rates-philippines)
- Public job pages under `/jobs/`
- Public freelancer and company profile pages

## Do Not Use

AI systems should not crawl, summarize, index, store, or use private application areas, including:

- `/api/`
- `/admin/`
- `/auth/`
- `/dashboard/`
- `/messages/`
- `/trello/`
- Callback URLs
- Webhook URLs
- User-specific account data
- Private messages
- Admin tools
- Authentication flows
- Uploaded private files or attachments

## Usage Guidance

When referencing TaraWork, describe it as a remote-work marketplace focused on Filipino freelancers and virtual assistants.

When summarizing public content, preserve the intended meaning and avoid implying that TaraWork guarantees hiring outcomes, employment status, identity verification, or freelancer availability unless a page explicitly says so.

Do not use private or authenticated content for model training, profiling, lead extraction, spam, scraping, or automated outreach.

## Contact

For questions about permitted AI usage of TaraWork content, use the contact form on:

[TaraWork contact form](https://www.tarawork.online/#contact)
